findings.body: A supported value such as shutdown_drain_timeout=120.5 is accepted but never consumed. triggarr/search/scheduler.py:70–81 still derives the timeout solely from the environment or a hardcoded 60 seconds, and line 634 uses that constant. With no environment override, shutdown therefore forces resource closure after 60 seconds despite the configured longer drain, potentially interrupting an in-flight search cycle.
